text: The Cauchy integral formula expresses the value of an analytic f inside a contour C as:
choices: f(a) = (1/(2*pi*i)) times the contour integral of f(z)/(z - a) dz
f(a) = the contour integral of f(z)*(z - a) dz
f(a) = (1/(2*pi*i)) times the contour integral of f(z) dz
f(a) = the sum of the residues of f
explanation: The Cauchy integral formula, f(a) = (1/(2*pi*i)) * integral of f(z)/(z - a) dz, recovers interior values from boundary data; differentiating under the integral yields every derivative as an integral, showing analytic functions are infinitely differentiable.
